notes: NEW GAMEPLAY: this is the fun-first rebuild of how a throw plays (v11 and earlier play like the old game).
New start screen: choose from 18 ragdolls (Ragnar + 17 others, each with its own stats and play style), then choose a city. Swipe or use the arrows.
Faster, flatter launch; limbs flail and he flips. Swipe left/right while airborne to add spin.
Pebble-skipping physics: he skips, bounces and ricochets off walls, roofs and signs instead of rolling to a stop; throws end quickly when the action is over.
Limbs can come off (and keep flying, bouncing, burning); cartoon blood (Settings > Gore ON/OFF).
Glass shatters, timber burns and fire spreads, TNT chains, different sounds for wood / glass / stone / metal.
8 stacking upgrades: launch power, bounce, ricochet, spin, durability, destruction, explosive impact, ignition. The upgrades screen has a +10,000 TEST button so you can try combinations at once.
New RAGDOLL TEST YARD map; the old big city is still selectable. Downtown, Old Town, Suburbia, Industrial District and Resort Strip are listed but locked (not built yet).
Hot Attic Games studio splash on startup.
